title: Route has no visible authentication or authorization gate before invoking vision processing
reasoning: The SDK router is mounted under a network-visible FastAPI prefix, and the locate-all handler accepts a client request and immediately resolves the supplied image and invokes the vision locate-all service using only the container dependency. No user/session/auth dependency or route-level authorization check is visible in the included file. Because this endpoint can process user-supplied image data and likely invoke expensive vision work, exposing it without an explicit auth boundary can allow unauthorized use or abuse if the router is reachable beyond a trusted local channel.
recommendation: Add or document an explicit authentication/authorization dependency for SDK vision routes, or enforce that this router is mounted only behind a trusted local/internal boundary. If the SDK API is intentionally unauthenticated, make that invariant explicit in code and tests so deployment changes cannot accidentally expose it.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for this feature, and the shown route has no auth-related assertions or dependencies to exercise.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a FastAPI route test for POST /api/sdk/vision/locate-all that verifies unauthenticated requests are rejected, or, if intentionally local-only, a mount/configuration test proving the route is unavailable on public API surfaces.
minimumFixScope: backend/src/api/routes/sdk/router.py plus the existing auth dependency or SDK router mounting configuration.
